name: Analytics
description: Analytics events on the canvas: the table of an event (name and properties), linked by an arrow to the element that fires it, and the transition annotated on the arrow between the source and the destination of a flow.

annotationTypes.name: Event
annotationTypes.description: Analytics event fired by an interface element. It is a loose table on the canvas (the event name and one row per property); the link to the element that fires it is an arrow, not a field.

fields.label: Name
fields.description: The event name as the analytics SDK receives it (checkout_started, button_click).

fields.label: Properties
fields.description: One row per property sent with the event: its name and the value or a description of the value.

columns.label: Value
columns.description: The fixed value or where it comes from (cart, list size, sum of prices).

examples.name: Checkout started
examples.description: Only the name goes in an example; the properties (source, items, total) come from the component preview.

annotationTypes.name: Transition
annotationTypes.description: Annotation of an arrow: the move from the source screen to the destination screen of a flow, with the condition under which it happens and, if any, the event that goes with it.

fields.label: Condition
fields.description: When the transition happens (tap on Subscribe, payment approved, session expired).

fields.label: Event
fields.description: The name of the analytics event fired on this transition, if any.
